display.title: The Month of Av: Ending Baseless Hatred with Ahavas Yisroel
display.summary_short: As the month of Av begins, Uncle Yossi explains that baseless hatred caused the Churban, and that loving every Jew is Hashem's greatest delight and the way to Moshiach.
display.summary_long: A short holiday talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show for the start of the month of Av. Uncle Yossi asks what caused the sad events of this month, above all the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash in Yerushalayim, and what we can do so they never happen again. Our Sages say the main cause was baseless hatred, which Hashem despises, while nothing pleases Him more than seeing His children love one another. Citing the Alter Rebbe, he compares Hashem to parents whose greatest joy is seeing their children live in harmony, since 'you are children to Hashem your G-d'. By practicing Ahavas Yisroel in every possible way we correct the mistakes of the past and pave the way for Moshiach, who will gather us from the four corners of the world to Eretz Yisroel.
display.lesson: Love every Jew; that is what Hashem wants most, and it will bring Moshiach.
